outlook.statement: Tariffs placed by the USA of 50% seriously dented profitability in FY 2025-26. The Supreme Court of the United States deemed them illegal and ordered the US government to return all tariffs collected, which should come back as a windfall in FY 2026-27.

Believes EBITDA can be improved by up to 500 bps by building more robust processes across the board including deeper vendor development, project management, cost optimising in secondary costs, plant speed optimisation, robust performance management system, and robust decision architecture at the plant.
Plan to exit both remaining commodity products by converting/replacing the last 3 remaining lines by FY 2027-28, concluding 11-year journey of overhauling product mix starting in 2016.
Released ₹35 crs of raw material inventory by creating a more robust import inventory management system.

Simplifying the corporate structure, improving organisational alignment, reinforcing leadership continuity, and maintaining a disciplined long-term perspective will continue to build on the foundations established during FY 2025-26, ensuring AYM Syntex Limited enters its next phase of growth with clarity, resilience, and purpose.

Focus shifts towards enabling technology to support every decision with greater speed, accuracy, and insight through SAP S/4HANA Phase-II Optimization, Cybersecurity & Digital Governance, and Enterprise Data Analytics Expansion.
India's textiles and apparel market is projected to reach ₹30 lakh Cr by 2030.
Global textile market estimated at USD 760.3 billion in 2025, projected to reach USD 974.4 billion by 2030, growing at CAGR of 5.1%.

The global business environment is expected to remain shaped by evolving trade policies, geopolitical developments, and changing supply chain dynamics. India continues to present one of the strongest long-term growth opportunities among major economies with real GDP projected to grow by 6.7% in FY 2026-27 and inflation expected to remain around RBI's target of 4.0%. The manufacturing sector is well positioned to benefit from sustained domestic demand, infrastructure investment, and increasing participation in global value chains, together with continued expansion of the textiles and apparel industry.

AYM Syntex Limited enters FY 2026-27 with a clear strategic direction. Continued investments in specialised products, digital capabilities, manufacturing excellence, and customer partnerships position the Company to respond to evolving market requirements with agility and precision. Guided by the three threads of People, Process, and Product, the Company remains focused on delivering sustainable growth, creating long-term value for stakeholders, and building a business equipped for the opportunities of tomorrow.
